_about: The world's own chances for sickness and injury (health.py; Docs/fable-audit-2026-11.md, 7.4). A draw is made only while its cause holds. `chance` is per day (per time the work is done, for the two hazards). Every value here is an ESTIMATE: none has a source, and `why` says what size it was meant to be. They are to be changed only toward realism, never to make a week livelier. `kind` is sickness or injury. `catching`: whether someone near can catch it.

rain_water.cause: drinking rain water that was not boiled
rain_water.onset: fell ill with {what}, from the rain water
rain_water.why: ESTIMATE. Roof and bin water drunk untreated: a real risk, but most days nothing happens. About one sickness per person in three weeks of drinking it.

wet_cold.onset: came down with {what}, after being wet and cold
wet_cold.why: ESTIMATE. One soaking in a cold house with little food: uncommon, not rare.

long_hunger.why: ESTIMATE. From 'thin and weak' on, dizziness and fainting are common within days. `raises` is how much every other chance grows for someone that weak.

room_mate.why: ESTIMATE. A night in the same small room with someone who has a stomach sickness.

tending.why: ESTIMATE. Lower than sharing a room: an hour at the bedside, not a night.

boards.why: ESTIMATE. Rough boards and nails handled daily by people who are tired: now and then.

carrying.why: ESTIMATE. Full containers carried by someone underfed.

night_scare.cause: a night trip that went wrong
night_scare.why: ESTIMATE. Running in the dark from something in the street: one time in four leaves a mark.

spared.cause: a night trip that nearly ended it
spared.onset: came back badly hurt, with nothing
spared.why: Not a chance: the rule that Leo is not lost in the first hour of play. The draw that would have lost him brings him back hurt instead, and the record marks it.

course.why: ESTIMATE. Each night a condition mends a level with chance `mend`, worsens with chance `worsen`; being looked after and keeping to bed help, hunger and thirst hurt. At home it never goes past bedridden.
